A: Where neighbours settle borders (negotiated order in 97 per cent of the defining members): the model's arrows into and out of neighbour talk and sparing are limited, and deals and help gain steps and conditions.
B: help traded, restraint and carrying on reworked

Three signatures, each held by 36 to 42 per cent of the defining members: help traded with neighbours (reciprocity), restraint toward other rooms (live and let live), and carrying the work to later canvases (transition).
C: keeping reworked: defence, repair and the chat that arranges them

Where the work is watched, repaired and defended (repair work in 90 per cent of the defining members): keeping gains conditions (sleep, shifts, numbers), the move after too few hands is limited, and part of the keeping is arranged in a chat.
D: the plan and its venue reworked: templates kept current and the chat's door kept

Where members share coordinates, templates and how-to and move planning into a chat (each in 65 per cent of the defining members): the template needs current versions and accurate geometry, and access to the planning chat needs upkeep.
E: the spot reworked: lost, chosen or yielded, and building again
Territoriality in every defining member: the move after a loss, choosing a spot, yielding space when asked, and the return from the move to building.
F: machine hands reworked, beside attack calls and records of the end

Scripts for the work in 98 per cent of the defining members: running, borrowing and withdrawing scripts, conditions on their use; a minority's signature share comes instead from attack calls or records of the end.
G: the mark's design and its marking reworked

Collective representation in 98 per cent of the defining members, completion ritual in half: settling the design, the publicity of the start, and celebrating the work. As placed, G also takes many rooms whose whole mix lies in other forms, since the design is a theme many rooms change.
one kind as cut; a mixture as placed
H: attack calls and mobilization reworked, with records of the end

Repertoire of contention in 70 per cent of the defining members, mobilization and collective memory in under half: attack calls, refusals and restraint toward them, calls to place, and records of how the work ended.
a mixture, with a raiding core
